body:
Ahoy, shipmate!

Today's the day! The tide is right and the wind is fair. We sail around the bay this morning, and you're one of the crew.

Come down to the harbour. Captain's orders!
summary: Sail around the bay and write the ship's log.

tasks.where: aboard Captain Mara's ship, at the coast (take the map)
at the coop by your house
in the grove behind the chapel
